summary: Andrea Kimi Antonelli's 111-point lead over Max Verstappen sets up a coronation-watch in Las Vegas, with the Mercedes driver needing to manage the gap across the final three races to secure the drivers' championship. George Russell's practice pace signals Mercedes could extend their commanding 142-point constructors' championship advantage over Ferrari, putting additional pressure on the Scuderia's title defense. A strong performance in Vegas would allow Antonelli to cruise through the remaining rounds with his maiden championship nearly secured, while any stumble could hand Verstappen renewed hope with Qatar and Abu Dhabi still to come.
